from datetime import datetime, timezone
import time

from google.cloud import logging_v2
from google.cloud.logging_v2.resource import Resource


def write_structured_log(payload, config=None):
    config = config or {}
    client = logging_v2.Client(project=config["project_id"])
    logger = client.logger(config["log_name"])
    timestamp_ms = payload.get("timestamp_ms", time.time() * 1000)
    logger.log_struct(
        payload["event"],
        timestamp=datetime.fromtimestamp(timestamp_ms / 1000, tz=timezone.utc),
        resource=Resource(type="global", labels={"project_id": config["project_id"]}),
    )
    return {"submitted": True}

from google.cloud import logging_v2
from google.cloud.logging_v2.resource import Resource

def write_correlated_logs(payload, config=None):
    config = config or {}
    client = logging_v2.Client(project=config["project_id"])
    logger = client.logger(config["log_name"])
    timestamp_ms = payload.get("timestamp_ms", time.time() * 1000)
    logger.log_struct(
        payload["event"],
        timestamp=datetime.fromtimestamp(timestamp_ms / 1000, tz=timezone.utc),
        resource=Resource(type="global", labels={"project_id": config["project_id"]}),
        correlation=payload["correlation_id"],
    )
    return {"submitted": True}

from google.cloud import logging_v2
from datetime import datetime, timezone

def query_error_logs(config, severity, start_time, end_time):
    client = logging_v2.Client(project=config["project_id"])
    logger = client.logger(config["log_name"])
    filter_ = f'severity={severity} AND timestamp>="{start_time.isoformat()}" AND timestamp<="{end_time.isoformat()}"'
    entries = logger.list_entries(filter_=filter_)
    return [entry.payload.fields for entry in entries]

from google.cloud import logging_v2
from datetime import datetime, timezone

def fetch_recent_logs(config, field, value, start_time, end_time):
    client = logging_v2.Client(project=config["project_id"])
    logger = client.logger(config["log_name"])
    filter_ = f'{field}={value} AND timestamp>="{start_time.isoformat()}" AND timestamp<="{end_time.isoformat()}"'
    entries = logger.list_entries(filter_=filter_)
    return [entry.payload.fields for entry in entries]

from google.cloud import logging_v2
from datetime import datetime, timezone

def incident_summary(config, severity, start_time, end_time):
    client = logging_v2.Client(project=config["project_id"])
    logger = client.logger(config["log_name"])
    filter_ = f'severity={severity} AND timestamp>="{start_time.isoformat()}" AND timestamp<="{end_time.isoformat()}"'
    entries = logger.list_entries(filter_=filter_)
    summary = {"total_errors": len(entries)}
    return summary

from google.cloud import translate_v2 as translate

def log_message_translate(log_text, target_language):
    client = translate.Client()
    result = client.translate(log_text, target_language=target_language)
    return result["translatedText"]

from sentence_transformers import SentenceTransformer

def log_embedding(log_text):
    model = SentenceTransformer('all-MiniLM-L6-v2')
    embedding = model.encode(log_text)
    return embedding
